raw.query: SELECT mode, COUNT(*) AS n_cells, MIN(spread) AS min_spread, AVG(spread) AS avg_spread, MAX(spread) AS max_spread, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spread > 0.05) AS cells_with_spread_gt_005, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spread > 0.10) AS cells_with_spread_gt_010 FROM (SELECT variate, resolution, mode, candidate, MAX(avg_wape)-MIN(avg_wape) AS spread FROM (SELECT variate, resolution, mode, candidate, model, AVG(wape) AS avg_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE span='common' AND h=-1 AND candidate='point' GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode, candidate, model) sub GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode, candidate) s GROUP BY mode;
raw.evidence: Unqualified claim fails: in uni mode across all 6 models, every cell has inter-model WAPE spread >0.10 (avg 0.34); claim holds only in restricted cov mode with 2 neural models (avg spread 0.005).
